the vm adapts state + envelope onto Bindings
how the checker knows what Process is
M0 ships the Process sheet only
in run, the world plays itself ;
in sim, the lab plays the world ;
a guest with I/O belongs behind
a late reply after closure is a
never causal, outside the golden seal
hash input, plan form, eval form
a plan with ERRORS is unrepresentable
faithful to the text, sugar intact
may hold error nodes — never lowered
the LAB is excluded from the hash
the host parser never reads a guest body
operator graph, in the database sense
no host references ; what ships to hosts
side table for diagnostics and traces
allocated at boot — a ledger is
ONE event at a time — the vm drains
between events, which may arm new
feeds Response back as vm input
— opaque so replica is never inlined ;
by the stable key ; late answer
THE engine — run and sim alike
no I/O, no clock, no randomness
arrival order captured in the journal
scratch isolation while a handler runs
Debug prints the name, never the value
no Serialize impl — leak = compile error
written by the RUNTIME MECHANICS only —
emission_id(node, trigger, parent, port, index) : envelope::Id
replay + conformance, not just the lab
one adapter file per connector, later
one due event at a time
«trait» = Rust trait ; realization ( ..|> ) = impl Trait for Type
-- = owned field ; ..> = uses / borrows ; inheritance does not exist
: M0 working conventions — types unprefixed, read
qualified (cel::Tree, world::Intent) ; x::X stutter is idiomatic ;
the corpus term outranks the rule
: «next» = not built in M0, APIs kept ready ;
«guarded» = reachable syntax refuses explicitly ; all else = M0 subset
: every module except `cel` may depend on
